subject: RE: BridgeCloud marketplace voucher issuance — PLG signup credits
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elena Petrov <elena@bridgecloud.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-25T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: BridgeCloud marketplace voucher setup for PLG signups

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier. As discussed, we're ready to route PLG signups that originate from BridgeCloud marketplace to receive a partner-issued voucher (self-serve) that grants $150 in Redwood API credits for 30 days.

Two asks to make this operational from our side:
- Can you confirm the voucher SKU or code format and whether you can bulk-provision codes via a CSV export?
- We need a webhook or reporting endpoint (or a weekly CSV) that lists redeemed codes including HubSpot contact email and external customer ID. This is for COGS reconciliation.

Looping in Camila (partner ops) to help with technical details and Marcus for finance visibility.

Ideal go-live: next Tuesday (2025-12-02) so the holiday cadence doesn't delay adoption. Is that realistic on your side?

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Elena Petrov <elena@bridgecloud.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marketplace Ops <marketplace@bridgecloud.com>
Date: 2025-11-25T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BridgeCloud marketplace voucher setup for PLG signups

Hi Vanessa —

Great to confirm scope. We can absolutely provision partner vouchers. Quick answers: 
- Voucher format: 16-char alphanumeric codes (BRG-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX). We can generate a CSV of 5k codes on demand.
- Reporting: Marketplace will provide a daily redemption CSV (GMT) with redeem_date, code, buyer_email, external_customer_id. We can also POST to a webhook if you provide an endpoint and auth token.

Two items from our side:
1) We need the exact redemption mapping you want: do you link by HubSpot email or by external_customer_id? HubSpot contact email is easiest for mapping to deals.
2) We require a signed partner voucher addendum (2 pages) that references the offer and revenue-share accounting. I'll attach a draft.

I'll attach a sample CSV and the draft addendum. If that's fine, we'll queue code generation and share the initial 500 codes for testing.

Best,
Elena Petrov
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
BridgeCloud

Attachments: bridgecloud_voucher_sample.csv, bridgecloud_partner_terms.pdf
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Petrov <elena@bridgecloud.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-26T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BridgeCloud marketplace voucher setup for PLG signups

Hi Elena —

Thanks — this all looks good. Operational notes from our side:
- Use HubSpot contact email as the primary key for redemption mapping. We'll reconcile external_customer_id where available but email is required for attribution to PLG flows.
- For the webhook: please POST to https://webhooks.redwood.com/partners/bridgecloud/redeem with header X-Partner-Token: <token-to-be-shared>. If you prefer SFTP drop, we can take that too.
- For testing: please send the initial 500 codes in CSV with columns (code, offer_amount_usd, expiry_date). We'll do an internal test by signing up via the marketplace link and applying a code.

Marcus — quick FYI: expected gross credit liability for initial program (Q4 pilot) is ~$12k if all distributed codes are redeemed. We'll monitor weekly.

Elena — we can sign the addendum electronically. Please send DocuSign link or a PDF to countersign.

Thanks,
Camila
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Petrov <elena@bridgecloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-27T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BridgeCloud marketplace voucher setup for PLG signups

Camila/Vanessa —

Uploaded the CSV and draft addendum to your shared folder and queued the 500-test codes. Sample code snippet from CSV: BRG-7J8K-3M2P-Q9L1.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/anchor/bridgecloud/redwood-voucher-addendum
Marketplace offer page: https://marketplace.bridgecloud.com/offer/redwood-inference-plg-voucher

We'll also enable the daily redemption export to start on Monday morning (GMT). Let us know when you have a test redemption so we can confirm mapping.

Regards,
Elena

Elena —

Test redemption complete (used code BRG-7J8K-3M2P-Q9L1). I received the confirmation page and the HubSpot lead (elena+test@bridgecloud-demo.com) created with UTM params intact. Redemption shows in our admin UI with email and external_customer_id present.

Next ops items:
- Camila, can you confirm we have the webhook token rotated into vault and that the webhook consumer will ACK on receipt?
- Marcus, can you confirm how you'd like the weekly COGS CSV to be formatted (gross credits issued vs redeemed vs expired)?

Elena — once the addendum is countersigned, happy to flip the switch to full issuance.

Thanks —
Vanessa
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Quick note from finance:

Format OK — please deliver weekly COGS CSV with columns: week_start_date, total_codes_issued, total_codes_redeemed, total_value_issued_usd, total_value_redeemed_usd, total_value_expired_usd, hubspot_export_link (if available). Send to finance@redwood.com and cc me. We'll book on grant liability monthly.

Also set an initial cap of $15k for the pilot period. If BridgeCloud expects to exceed that, escalate to me.

I'll review the addendum once DocuSign completes.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
